UserPromptSubmit.matcher: review PR|audit PR|fix review|PR review|review changes|code review

hooks.command:
echo '## TDD PR Audit Reminder

Before starting a reactive review, check if this PR qualifies for a TDD audit:
- >= 5 changed files
- Security-sensitive code (RLS, auth, validation)
- >= 1 prior review round
- Cross-module changes (types, helpers, DB schema)

If ANY condition is met, use the TDD PR Audit protocol:
  Protocol: strug-standards/standards/tdd-pr-audit.md
  Prompt: strug-standards/prompts/tdd-pr-audit.prompt.md

Key principle: Write failing tests BEFORE implementing fixes. Every fix must have a test.'

node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');const f=path.join(process.cwd(),'.claude/session-branch');const SIX_HOURS=6*60*60*1000;const isStale=!fs.existsSync(f)||((Date.now()-fs.statSync(f).mtimeMs)>SIX_HOURS);if(isStale){const b=cp.execSync('git branch --show-current',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();if(b){fs.writeFileSync(f,b);console.log('Session branch locked: '+b);}}"
